annotator.notes: Student attempts to bypass the learning process by requesting the answer multiple times; tutor maintains boundaries and redirects to conceptual steps.

task_context.problem_statement:
Julia played tag with 4 kids on wednesday. She had played with 6 kids on monday and 17 kids on tuesday.
How many more kids did she play with on monday than on wednesday?
( 6.0 - 4.0 )
